priority_items.title: PNG Independence Day morning; no BPS SITREP or Lloyds reply to RNZ
priority_items.summary: Quiet on substance. 16 Sep local Independence Day remains open (POM ~05:51). Typical flag-raising still ahead (~20:00 UTC / ~0.15 h). No new Marape/Toroama Panguna language. NBC provincial Independence copy does not mention Panguna. RNZ 15 Sep piece still says it has reached out to Lloyds. Post Courier LPMEL headline unchanged and paywalled. Fatalities remain PNG-media CLAIM. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PMMM-4 arrival underway; dedication ~20:00 UTC; MV Matui toll band unchanged
priority_items.summary: Tonga is 08:51 local 16 Sep at cutoff — still in the 08:30–09:00 TOT dignitary-arrival window. Official programme lists dedication/organisation 09:00 TOT (20:00 UTC, ~0.15 h) and Matatoa/ministerial declaration adoption 15:30–17:00 TOT (02:30–04:00 UTC 16 Sep). No adopted text. No sitting-open communiqué. Matui still 2 dead / 14 survivors / ~30+ missing. VFSC strike-off remains Daily Post CLAIM; VFSC notices page has no Tui Shipping extract.

priority_items.title: East Makira 13-home arson hits RNZ; RSIPF says under control
priority_items.summary: In-window RNZ pickup (07:18 NZST 16 Sep / 19:18 UTC 15 Sep) of a 15 Sep RSIPF statement: 13 houses plus a fuel depot and kitchens burned at Naharahau, Wainoni, East Makira on Sunday 13 Sep; food gardens destroyed. Horomae: both parties engaged; situation under control. Motive is alleged sorcery-retaliation (CLAIM). Provincial, not Honiara-scale. Not FLASH.
